job.title: Manager Assortment Allocation (m/w/d) – Vollzeit in Coesfeld-Lette (bei Münster)
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Good assortment allocation depends on clean product data and sharp analysis – product, catalog and pricing data across global channels has been my core work for five years.

– PIM-to-shop data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub
– Requirements, user stories, process mapping and UAT with business teams
– Daily use of generative AI / LLM tools in analysis, coding and docs
– JUnit test suites, code reviews, mentoring of juniors

I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. I am also an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User. My CV and cover letter are attached. Do you have time for a short call in the coming days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Assortment & E-Commerce Data Specialist | Product Catalog, Analysis & Processes
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce specialist with 5+ years on large B2B and B2C retail platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Deep experience with product catalogs, pricing and assortment data, PIM data pipelines and data consistency across global channels. Strong in business requirements analysis, process mapping, gap analysis and SQL-based data analysis together with business stakeholders. Uses AI tools extensively to speed up analysis and documentation and works in international agile teams. Works in international agile teams with Scrum, Jira and Confluence.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: Ernsting's family brings affordable fashion to hundreds of stores and online, and allocation decides how well the assortment sells. I want to bring five years of product catalog data, process analysis and data-driven work into a role where those numbers translate directly into business success. From Karlsruhe, with a valid work permit, I can start on 16 December 2026.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! Your Manager Assortment Allocation role caught my eye: 5+ years with product catalog and pricing data, process analysis and SQL for large retail platforms (Rockwell Automation, Shell). Start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Manager Assortment Allocation
en.hook: Allocating assortment well means getting the right product data to the right channel at the right time. Product, catalog and pricing data across global channels has been at the heart of my work for more than five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell, together with the business teams who own the assortment.

bullets.label: Product & assortment data
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub that keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Analysis & processes
bullets.text: In a techno-functional role I analyse requirements with business stakeholders and product owners, write user stories and functional specifications, map processes, support UAT and translate it all into SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Data quality
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed; engineered API migrations for customer account structures that improved stability and data consistency.

bullets.label: Data-driven tools
bullets.text: Use generative AI and LLM tools extensively to accelerate analysis, development, testing and documentation in day-to-day delivery.

en.logistics: I combine an analytical mindset with close collaboration with business teams. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I can strengthen Ernsting's family.
